_doc: Which root builds each module (owner decision D51). Read by scripts/gen_root_imports.py, which writes the roots and checks this mapping, and by the scripts that need to know a module's library (abi_hashes.py, kernel_replay.sh, prebuild_heavy.py, land-branch.sh, hq-status.py).

Every module under KAM/ belongs to exactly one library: the core library KAM (built by a plain `lake build`), or one certificate application listed below (an opt-in Lake library, built only by `lake build <lib>` through the serial capped driver).

A module belongs to an application when its name equals one of the application's prefixes or extends it by further name components; otherwise it is core. Rules checked by `scripts/gen_root_imports.py --check`: no module matches two applications; every module under an application_only prefix belongs to some application; a core module imports only core modules; an application module imports only core modules, its own modules and those of the applications it requires.

applications.title: SO-2: the Moon's spin-orbit band (N = 65 barrier tori)
SO-3: the Moon locked in synchronous rotation (N = 65 librational torus)
MAG: the magnetic field-line barrier at eps = 3/2500 (D66, D68)
